messages.subject: GCC Executive Leadership | Energy, Infrastructure, ESG and Corporate Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Naushad,

Your Dubai-based leadership recruitment work, including senior hiring across infrastructure, energy, operations, procurement and corporate functions, makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and country-facing coordination within a major gold-mining operation.

My current work includes senior engagement with ministries and regulators, renewable-energy transition, carbon-accounting governance, social performance, institutional partnerships and complex cross-functional matters with executive-level visibility. Across 12+ years, my experience spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE. I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across energy, infrastructure, mining, natural resources and industrial development. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate, residential and rotational assignments.

I would welcome consideration for current or upcoming Gulf leadership searches where institutional engagement, sustainability and country-facing execution fit the brief. My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
